definition:
noncomputable def angularDegreeComponent (n : ℕ+) (h : ℕ) (i : Fin (h + 1))
    (p : {p : ℕ // Even p ∧ 4 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ 2 ^ (64 * (h + 1))})
    (u : Fin (h - i.val + 1) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n.val))
    (ξ : EuclideanSpace ℝ
      ((Fin p.val × (Σ j : Fin (h - i.val + 1),
        Fin ((2 ^ (74 * (h + 1))) ^ j.val))) → Fin n.val)) : ℝ :=
  let S : ℕ := ∑ j : Fin (h - i.val + 1), (2 ^ (74 * (h + 1))) ^ j.val
  let a : ℝ := 1 / ((p.val : ℝ) ^ 4 * (S : ℝ) ^ 2 *
    Real.sqrt ((h - i.val + 1 : ℕ) * Real.log (2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ (64 * (h + 1)) * S)))
  Real.sqrt n.val * a * ∑ c, ξ c * ∏ s, u s.2.1 (c s)
signature:
theorem angularDegreeComponent_hasLaw (n : ℕ+) (h : ℕ) (i : Fin (h + 1))
    (p : {p : ℕ // Even p ∧ 4 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ 2 ^ (64 * (h + 1))})
    (u : Fin (h - i.val + 1) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n.val))
    (hu : ∀ j, ‖u j‖ = 1) :
    let S : ℕ := ∑ j : Fin (h - i.val + 1), (2 ^ (74 * (h + 1))) ^ j.val
    let a : ℝ := 1 / ((p.val : ℝ) ^ 4 * (S : ℝ) ^ 2 *
      Real.sqrt ((h - i.val + 1 : ℕ) * Real.log (2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ (64 * (h + 1)) * S)))
    HasLaw (angularDegreeComponent n h i p u)
      (gaussianReal 0 (((n.val : ℝ) * a ^ 2).toNNReal)) (stdGaussian _)

TYPING: EuclideanSpace uses the entrywise Euclidean norm, not the sup norm.
The probability space is the actual coefficient block with its standard Gaussian measure, not an arbitrary variable given its desired law.
STANDING: Positive integer n; natural level depth h; i ranges from0 throughh.
p is an even integer in4..P with P=2^(64(h+1)).
Unit directions are supplied for precisely the trailing blocks i..h.
SOURCE: hu is the source's sphere condition on directions.
derived_not_assumed: Its entrywise linear functional is measurable.
The Gaussian coefficient evaluation has mean0 and variance n*a^2.
The coordinate realization has the source tensor dimension n^(p*S).
The NNReal variance coercion does not truncate a negative real: n*a^2 is nonnegative.
